about_the_game:
Golem SMASH is currently in development

Come follow our development in our discord!

Embark on an epic quest as the last remaining golem, charged with the mission to restore peace to a poisoned land.

As a Golem, use interactive hand locomotion and your ability to grow in size and strength to defeat enemies, solve puzzles, and explore the world of Fernia.

Throughout your journey, you will be introduced to an ever evolving array of gameplay mechanics and abilities, crucial for navigating diverse environments and confronting your ultimate adversary, "Calamity".

This immersive VR experience caters to all playstyles whether that's strategic and skillful play or mindless action packed fun.

  • Intricate Hand Locomotion allowing for exciting movement and parkour

  • Size Manipulation that affects both movement and combat strategy

  • Exciting Physics-Based combat

  • Brain-teasing Puzzles and environmental Challenges

  • Abilities that evolve with each form, serving as both traversal tools and devastating weapons

In the ancient era, the revered Goddess of Peace NIERA engaged in a fierce conflict against the God of CALAMITY, a being who sought only chaos and ruin. After a devastating battle, Calamity was confined within a CELESTIAL CITADEL suspended in the heavens, leaving Niera with only a faint spark of her once-mighty power. To safeguard the fragile balance of nature and maintain the seal imprisoning Calamity, this final spark bestowed life upon the GOLEMS – formidable beings of stone able to harness the power of GRAVITON ENERGY.

From that day, tranquillity reigned over FERNIA as the Golems dutifully stood watch over the seal. However, from deep in the shadows, the PUKLIN ARMY - devout followers of Calamity - gradually recovered their strength and numbers. This continued for generations, until the day the Puklin army orchestrated a calculated assault on the citadel, freeing their malevolent deity and once again plunging the world into an era of darkness and despair.

With Calamity unleashed and Niera's whereabouts unknown, corruption spread across the land like a virulent plague, tainting all in its wake. As the lone surviving Golem, you are the last hope to vanquish Calamity and restore peace to the shattered world.

A game brought to you by TwinRune Studio

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR. Standing or Room Scale

short_description: An action-packed, physics-based VR game where YOU are a GOLEM with the ability to grow in size and strength! Use physics based combat and interactive hand locomotion to solve puzzles, defeat enemies and save the world from the clutches of Calamity!
